text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan's here, Trainer-chan's here!
The race is over, so let's get going already~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And then, and then, I wanna eat the racecourse's limited-edition sweets with you♪
choice_data_list: Before that, let's review the race...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Sure, I lost this time,
but I think I can win next time, you know??

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I've got a solid read on everyone's strength and how they take the track♪
I'll be fine, totally fine!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I've got a solid read on everyone's strength and how they take the track♪
I'll be fine, totally fine!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me☆ Maya's gonna run
beyond all your expectations! Because—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Subverting expectations in the best possible way...
that is the mark of a mature woman...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: 'Cause that's what it said in the book, silly♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll win and wrap Trainer-chan
right around my little finger! Oh yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if Trainer-chan says so,
I'll do my best, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, you're such a worrywart, aren't you??
choice_data_list: Because I want Mayano to take first place.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
Does that mean it's for Maya's sake?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Maya's gonna give it her all too~♪
